LESSON: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.4: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can you avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse
2. identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

Teach
• Today’s focus: state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse” using a school example.
• Model B for “state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example

• Model B for “identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse
• Model 2: identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse
2. Practise: identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• state why young people engage in alcohol, drugs and substance abuse
• identify five values needed to avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
